Receptionists went to the same school as that "computer says no" character from little Britiain.

Don't get me started on the app. It's about as useful as a chocolate toothbrush. I've never been sick until recently. They tried to call me once to talk to me about my sever illness and I didn't answer. So what would any sane person do? Obviously they wiped me from their records siting that I didn't pick up the phone (did they think I had died?). This meant that I couldn't get my repeat prescription, see my results in the NHS app, or request help on the evergreen app. I was on holiday and off grid but with wifi, so could only access via the app (also why I didnt answer). So I'm away, off grid for 2 months, unable to access my records, not sure if im still severly ill, or able to ask for help. Their email gets picked up once a week so thats pointless. It took them two weeks to put me back on the system and to get the NHS app back up and running took nearly a month.
The only good thing here is being able to book a blood test easily... No wait, that has changed too. It's nlw as hard as an appointment.
The end is necessary, even closer if this is your
